data_fields.name: stall_kill_after
data_fields.donor_constant: 60 s without a completed sync, and latency frames behind

best_idea: Stamp each client input with the tick it is due (last acknowledged tick plus a fixed delay), apply it only on that tick from a bounded queue, and checkpoint a small state hash every 32 ticks for desync checks.
decision_why: Take the stamped, bounded input intake for the server tick (row 18) and the 32-tick checkpoint ring as a replay check (row 19); reject the lockstep barrier, the 60-second stall kill and the peer kill on mismatch, because the server steps on its own clock and decides kills.
acceptance: Server test: an input acknowledged at tick 100 with a 2-tick delay is applied at tick 102 only; a client that stops acknowledging does not stop the server from stepping; a stored checkpoint at tick 64 equals the replayed checkpoint at tick 64.
